blocks.text: Yeh hormones cholesterol (ek qism ka lipid) se bante hain. Proteins ke bar-aks steroids lipid-soluble (charbi mein hal hone wale) hain. Is liye yeh cell membrane ke paar ja kar seedha nucleus ko hidayat de sakte hain. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Steroid hormones
rows: Metabolism qaboo karta hai aur jism ko stress (dabao) ka muqabla karne mein madad deta hai.
Gurdon (kidneys) ko namak aur pani ka tawazun rakhne mein madad deta hai.
Mardana reproductive tissues aur khasusiyat qaboo karta hai.
Zanana reproductive system aur us ke chakkar (cycle) ko qaboo karte hain.
